name: trace
description:
A compact activity log for AI agents.

- **`Trace`**: stacks `TraceLine`s — an optional `TraceIcon`, a `TraceTitle` and a `TraceDescription` — each with a `status` of running (shimmering title), pending or error.
- **`TraceCollapsible`**: wrap a line in it, with `TraceCollapsibleTrigger` and `TraceCollapsibleContent`, to reveal the details of a step.
